title: AI Demand Watch daily digest
description: One day of AI Demand Watch output. Written by the scheduled Claude run to docs/data/latest.json and docs/data/history/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Checked by scripts/validate_digest.py (stdlib only, no LLM).

run_date.description: UTC date of the run, YYYY-MM-DD.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the run, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-08T12:04:00Z.

sample.description: true only for the illustrative seed data shipped with the repo. Live runs always write false.

editor_summary.description: The editor agent's 2 to 3 sentence top-line summary.

agents.description: One entry per research agent in config.yaml, in config order.

signal_count.description: Signals from this agent that made today's digest (top plus watching).

id.description: First 12 hex chars of the SHA-256 of the canonical source URL (same canonicalization as state/seen.json).

tier.description: top = main digest item, watching = weaker footer signal.

severity.description: How large the impact on AI demand could be.

credibility.description: How sure we are the news is real and accurately reported (the researcher's confidence).

source_url.description: Canonical source URL. Every signal must cite one.

published.description: Publication date of the source, or null if unknown.
